ownership_contracts.ctx_lifetime: op-scoped; no cross-op reuse; revalidation-by-construction on the next op; flush-thread caller passes null and resolves in-handleChunk as before
ownership_contracts.lease_model: slot-per-purpose with held flags; distinct slots for gid (packed-decode witness), dv (per-cell independent witness), readback (native witness) — the three verification witnesses NEVER alias (SyncLeaseRegression check 1: planted wrong value in gid detected by dv)
ownership_contracts.native_address_lifetime: leased buffer address valid for the duration of each JNI call (no native retention after return); readback native side writes exactly 20480 bytes on success (rbr==0) so the fixed-offset full-region compare respects the written length
ownership_contracts.retained_memory: 20480B direct + ~53KB arrays per sync thread (LEASE_RETAINED_BYTES); no growth policy needed (fixed section sizes); C0 allocates ~225MB MORE churn per run instead
